The developer shows expertise in **test stability, modular design, and build system optimization** (e.g., Gulp), as well as **environment variable management and CI/CD integration** (e.g., Coveralls).

While contributions are **frontend-only**, the work reveals a **methodical approach to code quality, performance, and maintainability**, particularly in testing and infrastructure. No evidence of backend JavaScript, TypeScript, or mobile/web frameworks is visible in these contributions, but the **specialized frontend skills** (e.g., chart rendering, interactive DOM updates) suggest a strong ability to tackle complex frontend challenges. The experience level is assessed as **Mid** due to the **depth of Chart.js internals knowledge**, **testing improvements**, and **build system contributions**, which indicate **intermediate-to-advanced proficiency** in JavaScript ecosystems.
